verdict.rationale: Trello is a kanban-style project-management SaaS, not a coding agent or browser-automation tool. Having an agent verify its own implementation by navigating an app and taking before-and-after screenshots is outside this product category. The MCP server mention (trello-docs-6) only exposes Trello data to AI tools and is not evidence that Trello ships self-verification or screenshot capture.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent verify its own implementation by navigating the app and capturing before-and-after screenshots
